answer_1.quote: we introduce In-sightAgent, the first automated system capable of generating high-quality systematic reviews.
datasets: Corpora from 15 published systematic reviews in biomedical domain

answer_4.quote: We comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of InsightAgent using 15 existing systematic reviews in the biomedical domain with 9 domain experts and medical students.
answer_4.guideline: We use a rubric-based method in which each generated report is independently scored by two experts on multiple dimensions, such as comprehensiveness and writing quality, totaling 100 points.
